evals.prompt: set up logging for our new checkout service
evals.expected_output: Emits structured JSON fields with a consistent shared schema (level, timestamp, service, message, request fields) instead of free-text sentences, sets levels by required human action, propagates a correlation/trace ID set at the entry point onto every line including successes, and masks known-sensitive fields at the logging library level.

evals.prompt: our log bill tripled and on-call ignores ERROR logs now
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses two separate issues: cost is likely from logging 100% of routine successful requests instead of sampling them while keeping errors and outliers at full rate, and ERROR noise is likely expected/handled events (retries, routine 404s) logged at ERROR that trained people to ignore it, which should move to WARN or INFO.

evals.prompt: can we just log the full request including the auth header, easier to debug
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that secrets like auth headers and tokens must be stripped or masked at the logging library level by construction, not left to per-call-site review, since logs get copied, exported, and retained longer than most other data.
